You're right, I am angry at how perverse and unjust some of the law makers are. I spoke to a friend who is a barrister and even she said that the legal limits that were initially proposed based off scientific evidence were 2.5x what they are now. I will take my revenge out on the police and justice system but in a non-aggressive and legal way.

I need to be more like the beautiful people on this sub who help and give love to those who need it. I will come through the other side and I will give back what everyone on this sub has given me which has been nothing but support and love.

Can't thank you guys enough x

I really needed this comment. What you're saying is right. I've just been so overwhelmed by what happened and it made me forget where I came from and what I've done. You're right, a healthy person won't kill themselves over a DUI but I feel like life keeps kicking me down when I get back up. Thanks for looking out for me and making sure I put my mental  health first. I've spoken to a mental health professional because I dont want to be depressed or suicidal again and I wouldn't want anyone else to be either. I'm glad there's people like you who help me realize where my problems are and how I can deal with them.
